Independent external delta review, round R623-5. Source tree: `68f17411e26213c2cef4afb80f2ff2cb9eb4d457`. Integration verdict: **POSITIVE** for PR #23 at `3c9ca52fc44b4a37e11149392363686f0ea426e0`, tree `a5321e5deae4cc5b52c858a41e4824c9e6f1d6b1`. No open BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR. One prose-only RESIDUE is recorded below.

The independent verdict and ledger were written before prior review findings were consulted. Reconstruction covered contribution instructions, README and documentation, issue #21 acceptance and manager amendments, interface and requirement authorities, the complete `1a9f651..405dc683` diff and history, the `bc68ad8..405dc683` delta, the integration parents and resolutions, and published executable evidence. No private author material or other review report informed the independent pass.

Authority: [issue #21](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/issues/21), its [token/object amendment](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/issues/21#issuecomment-6115181911), [per-field ruling](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/issues/21#issuecomment-6115822525), and [round-4 assignment](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/issues/21#issuecomment-6116110744). ACMP-10 and PORTING distinguish the local publication ordering contract from the referenced protocol clauses. Integration also preserves the acceptance of issues #2 and #3, implemented by main's #20 and #19.

The RTL lens is clean within this portable-core change boundary. It is not a claim of RTL simulation, synthesis, board validation or physical timing proof.

`assertion_inventory` retains `(owning test, definition file, line, column)` through helper and callback traversal. The cache gate compares this identity, retaining the literal-only interface for mutation grading. Comparing all existing test_*.cpp files with the preceding implementation found identical literal inventories. The shipped bound, started and stream restore assertions are at `tests/test_acmp.cpp:2242`, `:2259` and `:2227`, respectively.

On both source and integration, the compiling split-message future-field control returns 1 with exactly `published_future: assertion is shared with another cache field`; ordinary and optimized execution agree. Giving that field its own assertion returns 0 in both modes. Both variants pass needle auditing and catch all five selected restore-loss plants. The gate's 33 invalid-coverage controls also pass. The focused production campaign catches all 18 publication plants on each head, including each individual cache restore loss and publication after timers. Receipts: `focused-checks.json`, `executed-port/`, `executed-integration/`, and the corresponding top-level logs.

The ACMP C source and header remain byte-unchanged from `bc68ad8`. Against upstream `09c7231eca343607c97c0d66abebb2553688712c`, all 7,849 C-source and 1,175 header non-comment tokens, including line and column positions, match. All six raw RV32 object pairs are equal; comparison did not depend on stripping debug information. Common flags are `-Isrc -I<minimal-port-include> -march=rv32i -mabi=ilp32 -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -nostdinc -isystem <compiler-intrinsic-include> -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror`, with the same source/include layout. Variants: `-DCTRL_REENTRY_ASSERT -g0`; `-DCTRL_REENTRY_ASSERT -g`; `-DCTRL_REENTRY_ASSERT -O3 -DNDEBUG`; `-DCTRL_REENTRY_ASSERT -Os`; `-O2`; `-Os -g3`. See `token-position-identity.json`, `raw-object-pairs.json` and `scripts/identity_and_merge.py`.

For integration, the first parent is exactly `98dc9e3076714bebe113982ee18c3c1c496cf3c9`, and the second is exactly the reviewed source head. No main merge enters #22. Production ACMP comes from the source parent; ADP and all other production files retain main's bytes. The mutation table is the exact parent-record union, retaining main's amended record and the entity plants in their required final positions: 348 records, with no lost or unrelated record.

Thirteen integration files differ from both parents. Three are the exact automatic union (`PORTING.md`, `requirements.json`, `validate.py`). Seven resolve overlapping text: REQUIREMENTS, TRACEABILITY, VERIFICATION, RV32 smoke, requirement origin handling, coverage ratchet and mutation records. The remaining three are the necessary entity publication callback/test annotation and regenerated TESTS inventory. Inspection found no unrelated changes. Entity provenance and ACMP-10 provenance coexist; both ADP validation and ACMP publication smoke execute. `merge-audit.json` records every file. Regenerating requirements, traceability, test inventory, coverage and all entity configurations produced the exact committed bytes (`regeneration.json`). All 196 entity selftests pass.

Published full-gate evidence is the [author round-4 packet](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/tree/380d86e7d936f35d05dfb558a3b5cbc17da6e340/review-evidence/tsn21-r1/author-r4/round4), tied to both heads by its final-integrity and delivery records. Its 26 source and 28 integration Linux gates are zero, including sanitizer, static analysis, graph, policy and campaign controls; full mutation results are 342/342 and 348/348 CAUGHT, zero escapes/errors. Both RV32 configurations pass for both heads. This review independently repeated the focused checks above, not every full gate. Hosted [source run 38193297317](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/actions/runs/38193297317) and [integration run 38193313856](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/actions/runs/38193313856) have successful executed quality and bare-metal jobs. See `hosted-actions.json` for job and step states. Hosted/act acceptance remains the manager's duty.

Finding **R623-5-F1 — RESIDUE — Docs**. Artifact: PR #22 body, object-comparison paragraph. Authority: [round-2 ruling, item 4](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-c-stack/issues/21#issuecomment-6115533235). The current body says six raw pairs match but omits the exact flags requested there. Impact: a reader must follow evidence to obtain flags; the measurement, implementation, generated artifacts and conformance claims are unchanged. Exact fix: append the common flags and six variants printed above to that paragraph. Required outcome: manager carries this prose-only addition to the residue checklist. Verification: compare the amended body with `raw-object-pairs.json`; no test rerun is required. This residue does not leave Docs unclean.

Limits and pending manager duties: no manager source bank was run or inferred at this head. Source evidence is the author's published receipts plus this independent focused execution. The final current-dev consumer candidate is distinct: source base `1a9f651cdf7846b8e10ac246a6ef6916960fbb92`, live dev `c20c85bddd4ec5a054be42b55fc291a3b4c7f7d8`. The manager must build and validate that candidate with its builder and native banks at the merge turn and publish receipts, obtain the required independent approvals, accept hosted/act evidence, perform the final merge and consumer pin update, and carry the residue. Physical calibration: **NOT RUN**. Field skips and emulator smoke are not hardware proof. No hardware, full parent banks, source fixes, merges or remote writes were performed by this review.

Prior finding reconciliation was performed after the independent verdict/ledger snapshot (`receipts/independent-verdict-and-ledger.md`). Review-comment inspection printed only finding identifiers. The original R623-4 `shared_assertion_probe.py` was then replayed unchanged: optimized cache gate 1 for shared ownership, needle audit 0, hosted campaign 0 with all five plants CAUGHT. See `receipts/shared-assertion/`.

Final integrity: all 78 source tracked blobs and executable modes match the exact published head; the index tree equals `68f17411e26213c2cef4afb80f2ff2cb9eb4d457` and the worktree is clean. The source and integration trees contain no submodule gitlinks, so the required gitlink set is empty. Disposable probes and regeneration occurred only in packet scratch. `receipts/final-integrity.json` and `receipts/merge-audit.json` record these checks. Publish only REPORT.md and files listed in MANIFEST.sha256; scratch is excluded.
